en:
That's true...
That's another way of looking at it.

...So that's how the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL> feels about it, huh?
Ah, no, I was simply pointing out...

I know, I know...
But...

Just the possibility... Going through
something like this is rough.
Rantaro...

I'm sorry, I shouldn't have
even brought it up.

It's just...dumb.
Forget I even said anything.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's that smile again... Like he's pushing
me away, he doesn't want me involved...

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems like that didn't
go well...
No, that can't be the case.

...How can you be so sure?
Not even a reasonable doubt?

We were chosen by Monokuma because
we have <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate talents<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

It would be too peculiar to have just
one person with no talent involved.
Well, that's true, but...

I wonder why...I'm trying so hard to
convince myself I don't have a talent.

Haha...
Guess I've always been a little negative.

I still have a long way to go, after all.
I just have to wait for my memories to return.
<CLT=cltMIND>I think this conversation went well.

A talent you don't want to remember...
Like, say, a criminal one?
...Yeah.

I wouldn't want to turn out to be, like, the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pyromaniac<CLT=cltNORMAL> or <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Murderer<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

It could be a talent that would
cause significant problems around here.
...So what is it you're trying to say?
...What?

My talent could be something
dangerous. You know it, I know it.

But the person most afraid of that...
is *me*.

So I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't say
things that make me worry more, okay?
<CLT=cltMIND>Damn, this is awkward...

A talent you don't want to remember...
Like, say, a criminal one?
...Yeah.

What if I erased my memories on purpose
because I was a murderer or something...?
No, I don't think that's it.

But how can you be *sure*?
You can't say that so casually...
I'm sure because I know you.

I've only known you a short time, but I
feel like I understand you, Rantaro.

From what I know, you aren't someone
who would commit cold-blooded crimes.

That's my conclusion, as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...Isn't that good enough?
I'm sorry.
What?
No, I guess I'm not "sorry"...
I'm...grateful.

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL> is on my side.
That is definitely good enough.

Thank you, Shuichi. Guess I'll just stay
positive and keep waiting for my memories.

<CLT=cltMIND>Good, it seems like
we both had a lot of fun.
